description: What one decision cites: the provisions (with how often) and the decisions it relies on. Example: {"case": "KORE313182017"}

case.description: A juris doknr, an ECLI, or this site's decision URL as `search` returns it. The canonical decision key `{court}/{date}/{slug}` (e.g. `bgh/2024-07-10/viii-zr-276-23`) is accepted wherever a doknr is; a key that names two decisions answers `ambiguous` with `candidates`.

lang.description: Language of the decision text: 'de' or 'en'. Default: German when it exists, else English.

offset.description: Skip this many cited decisions (pages of 50). Follow `pagination.next_offset`.

name: listCitedAuthorities
title: List cited authorities
